messages:
maria: Quick ping on PM-112 follow-ups 
We still have 2 overdue items in the tracker. Owners, confirm status or update ETA.
jon: Which ones are overdue now? I saw the rollback doc updated last week.
sam: Rollback is done, but the canary alert (item #4) wasn't merged. I left comments on the PR.
olivia: Right, PR is WIP. I hit a flaky test; will re-run CI and push fix today. ETA: EOD.
dinesh: Heads-up: the canary needs an additional alert filter so ops doesn't get noise during heavy traffic. I can help review the query.
maria: Good call @dinesh. Also item #6, "run recurrence analysis", was never assigned 
This is concerning because we saw the same error 3x in 20 days. Who can own it?
jon: I can take the recurrence analysis but I need access to the archived traces. Sam, do you have the archive location?
sam: Yep: gs://incidents-archive/pm-112/traces-2024-06.tar.gz
jon: Thanks. I'll pull that and run a clustering pass this afternoon. Will report back with any common stack traces.
incident-bot: Reminder: PM-112 actions overdue: canary alert (olivia), recurrence analysis (unassigned). Escalation email will go to eng-directors in 36h if not updated.
maria: Since we've got owners now, I'm locking expectations: olivia -> canary alert PR (fix flaky test & merge) by EOD today; jon -> recurrence analysis findings by tomorrow noon; sam -> ensure alert doesn't fire on normal load (coaching w/ dinesh). If anything slips, flag here immediately.
olivia: Acknowledged. Working on test fix now. If CI still flakes I'll file an incident and mark blocked.
dinesh: I'll do a quick review after CI passes. Also suggest we add a smoke job to run the alert query once a day on staging. Sam, can you add that to infra backlog?
sam: Yep, adding a ticket: INFRA-874. ETA for smoke job: 2 weeks.
jon: Quick note on the analysis approach: I'll run a time-windowed fingerprinting + message clustering and also check for correlation with deploys. If I find a deploy correlation I'll propose a quarantine rule.
maria: Sounds good. Please attach any queries and artifacts to the PM-112 postmortem doc.
incident-bot: Escalation queued in 24h for PM-112 unresolved items.
johnathan: (reaction) :eyes:
maria: Final ask 
please reply with "done" here when each action is closed so I can mark them complete and update the postmortem. I'll escalate to Eng Directors if any item remains open past the next 36h. Thanks team.
